column1: # Shared XDG_* absoluteness vectors (#774). On Unix (Linux, macOS, WSL) an
# XDG_* value is honoured iff it starts with `/`; Windows spellings, relative
# paths, `~`, empty and leading-space values are ignored. Read by ALL FOUR
# implementations so they cannot drift apart:
# Format: one vector per line, tab-separated: value<TAB>absolute (yes|no).
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored. `value` uses the mini
# escape scheme of cache_key_vectors.tsv (\\ -> one backslash) plus the single
# whole-column token \e meaning the EMPTY string (an empty column would be
# collapsed by bash/zsh `read`). Every reader MUST fail if this file is
